note: What a server sends to put a champion on the field. It arrives on its own and also inside EnterSight. The header carries zero or names the object this is about; a client accepts either.

fields.name: champion
fields.note: The name the champion answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat holding it, or a negative number where no seat does.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to, in a field of its own.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: What level the champion's own spells stand at.

bits.name: side
bits.note: Which of the two sides the champion is on. A server sets it.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server writes zero.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: How well it plays where nobody holds it.

fields.name: spawnIndex
fields.note: Which of its side's starting places the champion begins at, counted from zero. Where a champion first stands travels in EnterSight. A server can send 0 for every champion; where a champion stands is settled by the movement or sight data that follows.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat holding it is called. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long it stays down, in seconds, where it is already down.

fields.name: downFor
fields.note: How long it has already been down, in seconds.

fields.name: deathKind
fields.note: What sort of death it is already in, where it is already down.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server writes zero.
